blocks.en: We now consider the problem \eqref{eq:weighted-elliptic-general-system} with boundary condition \eqref{eq:weighted-elliptic-general-boundary-conditions}. We write the equations in the compact form $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ and $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$ and we denote by $\mathcal{A}$ the operator which maps $\bm{u}$ to $(\bm{L}\bm{u},\bm{B}\bm{u}|_{\partial\Omega})$. In choosing weights, we shall now make the convention that $s_i\leq0$ and $t_j\geq0$ for all $i$ and $j$; this can always be achieved by subtracting a constant from the $s_i$ and $r_l$ and adding the same constant to the $t_j$. Let $t\prime=\max_jt_j$, $M_1=\max(0,\max_lr_l+1)$. Then the following holds.
blocks.zh: 现在考虑问题 \eqref{eq:weighted-elliptic-general-system} 及边界条件 \eqref{eq:weighted-elliptic-general-boundary-conditions}. 将方程简写为 $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ 和 $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$, 并用 $\mathcal{A}$ 表示将 $\bm{u}$ 映到 $(\bm{L}\bm{u},\bm{B}\bm{u}|_{\partial\Omega})$ 的算子. 选取权重时, 现在约定对所有 $i$ 和 $j$ 均有 $s_i\leq0$ 和 $t_j\geq0$; 总可以从 $s_i$ 和 $r_l$ 中减去一个常数, 同时将相同常数加到 $t_j$ 上来做到这一点. 令 $t\prime=\max_jt_j$, $M_1=\max(0,\max_lr_l+1)$. 那么有以下结论.

blocks.en: The result thus consists of a regularity statement and an a priori estimate. Agmon, Douglis and Nirenberg actually prove more than we have stated; they establish similar results in $L^p$-based Sobolev spaces and also in Hölder spaces. We also note that some of the smoothness hypotheses on $\Omega$ and the coefficients can be weakened. We shall not pursue this point here. A proof of the theorem is beyond the scope of this introductory text. However, we refer to Sections~\ref{sec:elliptic-interior-regularity} and \ref{sec:elliptic-boundary-regularity} for a proof of a special case, namely, second-order elliptic PDEs with Dirichlet boundary condition. We next derive an interesting corollary.
blocks.zh: 因而该结果由正则性陈述和先验估计组成. Agmon, Douglis 和 Nirenberg 实际证明的内容比这里陈述的更多; 他们在基于 $L^p$ 的 Sobolev 空间以及 Hölder 空间中都建立了类似结果. 还应注意, 关于 $\Omega$ 和系数的某些光滑性假设可以减弱. 这里不进一步讨论这一点. 定理的证明超出本入门教材的范围. 不过, 一个特殊情形, 即具有 Dirichlet 边界条件的二阶椭圆 PDE, 的证明参见 Sections~\ref{sec:elliptic-interior-regularity} 和 \ref{sec:elliptic-boundary-regularity}. 下面导出一个有趣的推论.

blocks.en: Let all assumptions be as in the preceding theorem. Assume in addition that $M+t_j>0$ for every $j$. Then the operator $\mathcal{A}:X_M\to Y_M\times Z_M$ is semi-Fredholm.
blocks.zh: 作与前一定理相同的全部假设. 再假设对每个 $j$ 都有 $M+t_j>0$. 那么算子 $\mathcal{A}:X_M\to Y_M\times Z_M$ 为半 Fredholm 算子.
blocks.label: cor:adn-boundary-operator-semi-fredholm

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
It easily follows from the smoothness hypotheses on the coefficients that $\mathcal{A}$ does indeed map $X_M$ to $Y_M\times Z_M$. Let $N(\mathcal{A})$ be the nullspace of $\mathcal{A}$, and let $B$ be the intersection of $N(\mathcal{A})$ with the unit ball in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. By the theorem, $B$ is bounded in the norm of $X_M$, hence precompact in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. Since the unit ball in an infinite-dimensional space is never precompact, $N(\mathcal{A})$ must be finite dimensional.

Next, we shall show that the range of $\mathcal{A}$ is closed. For that purpose, assume that $\bm{u}_N$ is a solution of $\bm{L}\bm{u}_N=\bm{f}_N$ with boundary conditions $\bm{B}\bm{u}_N=\bm{g}_N$, and that $\bm{f}_N$ and $\bm{g}_N$ converge in $Y_M$ and $Z_M$ to $\bm{f}$ and $\bm{g}$, respectively. Without loss of generality, we may assume that $\bm{u}_N$ is perpendicular to $N(\mathcal{A})$ in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. We claim that $\bm{u}_N$ is then bounded in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. Suppose not. After taking a subsequence, we may assume $\|\bm{u}_N\|_2\to\infty$. Let $\bm{v}_N=\bm{u}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$. Then $\bm{v}_N$ solves the problem $\bm{L}\bm{v}_N=\bm{f}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$ with boundary conditions $\bm{B}\bm{v}_N=\bm{g}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$. It follows from \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate} that the sequence $\bm{v}_N$ is bounded in $X_M$. Hence it has a subsequence which converges weakly in $X_M$, hence strongly in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. Let $\bm{v}$ be the limit. Then $\bm{v}$ is in the nullspace of $\mathcal{A}$ and in its orthogonal complement, hence zero. But this is a contradiction, since $\|\bm{v}\|_2=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|\bm{v}_N\|_2=1$. Since $\bm{u}_N$ is bounded in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$, \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate} implies that it is also bounded in $X_M$. Hence after taking a subsequence, $\bm{u}_N$ converges weakly in $X_M$ and strongly in $(L^2(\Omega))^k$. Applying \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate} again, we see that $\bm{u}_N$ actually converges strongly in $X_M$. The limit $\bm{u}$ is a solution of $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ with boundary conditions $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$.
blocks.zh:
由系数的光滑性假设容易得到, $\mathcal{A}$ 确实将 $X_M$ 映到 $Y_M\times Z_M$. 设 $N(\mathcal{A})$ 为 $\mathcal{A}$ 的零空间, $B$ 为 $N(\mathcal{A})$ 与 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中单位球的交集. 由该定理, $B$ 在 $X_M$ 的范数下有界, 因而在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中预紧. 由于无穷维空间中的单位球绝不可能预紧, 所以 $N(\mathcal{A})$ 必有限维.

接着证明 $\mathcal{A}$ 的值域是闭的. 为此, 假设 $\bm{u}_N$ 解 $\bm{L}\bm{u}_N=\bm{f}_N$, 满足边界条件 $\bm{B}\bm{u}_N=\bm{g}_N$, 并且 $\bm{f}_N$ 和 $\bm{g}_N$ 分别在 $Y_M$ 和 $Z_M$ 中收敛到 $\bm{f}$ 和 $\bm{g}$. 不失一般性, 可假设 $\bm{u}_N$ 在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中垂直于 $N(\mathcal{A})$. 断言此时 $\bm{u}_N$ 在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中有界. 反设不然. 抽取子序列后, 可假设 $\|\bm{u}_N\|_2\to\infty$. 令 $\bm{v}_N=\bm{u}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$. 那么 $\bm{v}_N$ 解问题 $\bm{L}\bm{v}_N=\bm{f}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$, 并满足边界条件 $\bm{B}\bm{v}_N=\bm{g}_N/\|\bm{u}_N\|_2$. 由 \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate}, 序列 $\bm{v}_N$ 在 $X_M$ 中有界. 因而它有一个在 $X_M$ 中弱收敛, 从而在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中强收敛的子序列. 设 $\bm{v}$ 为极限. 那么 $\bm{v}$ 同时属于 $\mathcal{A}$ 的零空间及其正交补, 因而为零. 但这产生矛盾, 因为 $\|\bm{v}\|_2=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|\bm{v}_N\|_2=1$. 由于 $\bm{u}_N$ 在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中有界, \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate} 说明它在 $X_M$ 中也有界. 因而抽取子序列后, $\bm{u}_N$ 在 $X_M$ 中弱收敛, 并在 $(L^2(\Omega))^k$ 中强收敛. 再次应用 \eqref{eq:adn-elliptic-system-apriori-estimate}, 得到 $\bm{u}_N$ 实际在 $X_M$ 中强收敛. 极限 $\bm{u}$ 为 $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ 的解, 满足边界条件 $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$.
